SELECT DATE_FORMAT(nc.visitTime, '%Y-%m-%d') AS periodDate, nc.typeString, COUNT(*) AS chargeCount, COUNT(DISTINCT nc.patientName) AS visitCount, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(nc.amount), 0), 2) AS totalAmount, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(nc.amount), 0), 2) AS chargeTotal, ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(nc.amount), 0), 2) AS chargeAvg, 0 AS actualTotal, 0 AS actualAvg, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(nc.amount), 0), 2) AS notChargedTotal, ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(nc.amount), 0), 2) AS notChargedAvg, ROUND( (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.returnAmount), 0) FROM bq_bill_refund r WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND DATE_FORMAT(r.returnTime, '%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(MIN(nc.visitTime), '%Y-%m-%d')) , 2) AS refundTotal, 0 AS refundAvg, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(nc.amount), 0) - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.returnAmount), 0) FROM bq_bill_refund r WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND DATE_FORMAT(r.returnTime, '%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(MIN(nc.visitTime), '%Y-%m-%d')) , 2) AS profitTotal, 0 AS profitAvg FROM bq_bill_not_charged nc
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(nc.visitTime, '%Y-%m-%d'), nc.typeString ORDER BY periodDate DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT 1 FROM bq_bill_not_charged nc
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(nc.visitTime, '%Y-%m-%d'), nc.typeString ) t
